name: Unidentified knobbly-headed species
description: This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their large, three-toed feet, as well as massive, three-fingered hands. They also possessed long faces with knobbly craniums. In 4 ABY, two members of this species traveled aboard a transport known as the Tippler's Groan headed from Darsie to the planet Phorliss alongside the Human Mara Jade.
